integrity: All formulas are derived from explicit geometric arguments and supported by two independently executed exact arithmetic programs. These computations are finite checks and do not substitute for the infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the untwisted Clebsch diagonal cubic in characteristic greater than five; the split-field point count is classical. The inaccessible full text of Hirschfeld (1981) leaves residual historical priority uncertainty for possible equivalent nonsplit counts.
title: Arithmetic incidence and zeta function of the Clebsch cubic's line complement
